content: #2 projective object says in remark 5 that projective resolution (def 4) is an injective resolution for that and that model structure on the category of chain complexes. Is this correct ?
subject: projective, free, injective; presented, covered and resolved

content:
#3 Ah, thanks for catching this, this is supposed to say “cofibrant resolution”:

a projective resolution of chain complexes is precisely a cofibrant resolution in the standard Quillen model structure on chain complexes (the first of the two behind that link).
